english.title: Wilful obstruction of a highway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, wilfully obstructed the free passage along a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HIGHWAY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 137(1) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority / excuse
wilfully obstruct
free passage along highway

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 12th May 2022 due to a change in penalty introduced by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022. For the offence applying before that date, see H488.
(ii) For obstruction by persons or items other than motor vehicles, see offence wording H100653, and H3850 for failing to comply with order to remove obstruction.
(iii) See section 328 for meaning of 'highway'.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant without lawful authority or excuse, wilfully obstructed the free passage along a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HIGHWAY..).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Fixed penalty ticket - Thirty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
